skill.name: requesting-code-review
skill.description: Request structured code reviews after tasks, major features, or pre-merge changes to verify quality, tests, and readiness.
skill.summary: Guides structured code review requests for implementation work before merge.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Static findings were mostly markdown formatting and code-review example text, not malicious behavior. A medium hardening issue remains because the review template places commit placeholders directly inside shell commands.

remediation.issue: Commit placeholders are embedded directly in shell commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require full Git SHAs or trusted refs before execution, and pass values as command arguments instead of shell text.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Shell Placeholders in Review Template
semantic_findings.description: The template shows `{BASE_SHA}` and `{HEAD_SHA}` directly inside git diff shell commands. If those fields contain shell metacharacters and the block is executed in a shell, the command can be changed.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines are shell commands with placeholder values, so the injection path depends on how callers fill and execute them.

content.value_statement: Code changes often miss defects until late review. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to request structured review before merge.
actual_capabilities: Defines when to request a code review during development tasks.
Shows how to collect base and head Git SHAs for review.
Provides a review prompt template with severity categories.
Guides reviewers to compare implementation against requirements.
Encourages fixes for critical and important issues before continuing.
limitations: It does not run tests or inspect code by itself.
It depends on accurate Git SHAs and requirement context.
It requires a compatible review agent or manual review process.
It can miss issues if the supplied diff is incomplete.

use_cases.title: Pre-Merge Quality Check
use_cases.description: Request review before merging a feature branch into main.

use_cases.title: Task-Based Agent Workflow
use_cases.description: Ask for review after each completed agent task to catch regressions early.

use_cases.title: Bug Fix Verification
use_cases.description: Review a complex bug fix against the original failure and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Last Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my latest change for correctness, tests, and merge readiness. Use the provided review template and list critical issues first.

prompt_templates.title: Review Against Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changes from {BASE_SHA} to {HEAD_SHA} against this requirement summary: {PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS}. Identify missing behavior and test gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Agent Task Output
prompt_templates.prompt: Review task {TASK_NUMBER} from my implementation plan. Compare the diff, acceptance criteria, and tests. Recommend whether I should continue.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Release Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a production readiness review for the release diff. Assess architecture, security, migrations, backward compatibility, and operational risks.

output_examples.input: A developer finished a feature and needs review before merge.
output: Strengths: The implementation follows the requested flow and includes targeted tests.
Important issue: The error path lacks coverage and should be tested before merge.
Assessment: Ready with fixes before merge.

output_examples.input: An agent completed task two in a longer implementation plan.
output: Strengths: The task matches the plan and keeps scope narrow.
Minor issue: The progress message could be clearer for users.
Assessment: Ready to continue to the next task.

best_practices: Request review after meaningful changes, not only at the end of a project.
Provide the requirement summary, base commit, head commit, and test results.
Fix critical and important findings before starting the next task.
anti_patterns: Submitting a vague review request with no requirements or diff range.
Treating minor style comments as blockers for production readiness.
Ignoring valid findings because the feature appears simple.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps you request structured code review after implementation work and before merge.

faq.question: Does it review code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a workflow and template for a compatible review agent or reviewer.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the requirement summary, base commit, head commit, implementation summary, and test status.

faq.question: Does it execute commands?
faq.answer: It describes Git commands users may run. Review command inputs before executing them in a shell.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it after major tasks, complex bug fixes, and before merging code to main.
